summary: safeGit now returns a { code, stdout, stderr } object instead of the stdout string, and it no longer throws when git fails. index.ts also exports the new GitResult type.

findings.title: safeGit return shape change breaks both CLI callers
findings.problem: safeGit now returns a GitResult object and no longer throws. currentBranch in packages/cli/src/branch.ts:7 and changedFiles in packages/cli/src/status.ts:7 still call string methods on that result and rely on a throw.
findings.consequence: In currentBranch, trim throws a TypeError and the catch returns null, so main.ts always exits early. In changedFiles, split throws a TypeError, and failed git commands no longer reach callers as errors.
findings.fix: Update currentBranch to return null when code is not 0 and otherwise trim stdout. Update changedFiles to check code and split stdout.

findings.title: No test covers the new safeGit result and error path
findings.problem: safeGit gained a new return shape and a catch branch that maps errors to an exit code. No test in this change exercises either path.
findings.consequence: A test calling currentBranch or changedFiles would have caught the broken callers before the push.
findings.fix: Add tests that call safeGit with a succeeding and a failing git command and check code, stdout and stderr.
